comparability.oneScansPredatesAnalysis: One of the scans predates analysis revisions, so what it measured is unknown. Scan it again to compare.
comparability.scansWereReadDifferent: The scans were read by different analyses (revision {ra} and {rb}); their numbers mean different things.
comparability.scansIgnoredDifferentPaths: The scans ignored different paths, so they did not read the same code.
comparability.differentLanguagePacksRan: Different language packs ran ({extensions} and {extensions2}); counts that depend on them may shift.

comparabilityGate.theseTwoSnapshotsWere: These two snapshots were not read the same way
comparabilityGate.differencesBetweenThemMay: Differences between them may come from the scan, not the code. Rebuild the baseline at its own commit with this build's analysis, and the two compare number for number.
comparabilityGate.scanRunningGateClears: A scan is running; the gate clears when the rescan is done.

structureCompare.orderedGroupPairsLeast: Ordered group pairs with at least one import
structureCompare.fileImportsWhoseTwo: File imports whose two ends sit in different groups
structureCompare.groupPairsImportEach: Group pairs that import each other
structureCompare.twoGroupsEachImporting: Two groups each importing the other
structureCompare.groupsStronglyConnectedSet: Groups in a strongly connected set
structureCompare.productionCodeFilesOutside: Production code files outside every group
